scope: CVG-002C6 bounded inpatient inventory charge capture

criteria.description: The bounded inventory-to-billing slice, its owner, dependencies and explicit limits are recorded without claiming the complete clinical-financial journey.
criteria.limitations: Discharge, receipt, journal, outbox, provider, deployment and release remain outside this bounded gate.

criteria.description: The price source, inventory source idempotency, CAS retry, tenant/encounter database invariant and HTTP/UoW boundary are coherent enough for the bounded implementation.
criteria.limitations: The source price is explicit on inventory_items; catalog/price-table linkage and full settlement remain future work.

criteria.description: The RED/GREEN tests cover real HTTP, PostgreSQL, replay, distinct-key concurrency, no-price rejection, two-tenant isolation and direct SQL stay integrity.
criteria.limitations: Same-key payload conflict, per-write failpoints, outbox semantics and the full admission-to-receipt journey remain open.

authority.scope: CVG-002C6 bounded inpatient inventory charge capture
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation, disposable PostgreSQL and local HTTP verification for the bounded inpatient inventory charge-capture slice; full clinical-financial journey, production, providers, credentials, deployment and release remain excluded.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before expanding to external providers, credentials, production, deployment, irreversible migrations, full financial settlement or release acceptance.

next_action: Extend the bounded C6 slice into discharge, receipt, journal and outbox with failpoints and full HTTP/PostgreSQL evidence before any broader gate promotion.
revalidation_triggers: Expansion from bounded inventory charge capture to full clinical-financial settlement
Changes to source price semantics, billing source uniqueness, transaction scope or database trigger invariants
A regression, security scan or independent review finds a Critical/High/Medium issue
